map.支持 IPSS-MF / DIPSS / DIPSS-plus 预后评分，用于原: Supports IPSS-MF / DIPSS / DIPSS-plus prognostic scoring for survival risk stratification in primary myelofibrosis
map.原发性骨髓纤维化按 IPSS-MF / DIPSS / DIPSS-plus 定: Primary myelofibrosis risk stratification by IPSS-MF / DIPSS / DIPSS-plus
map.看中位生存与移植适应证（高危/中危-2 考虑异基因移植）: Look at median survival and transplant indication (allogeneic transplant for high risk or intermediate-2)
map.症状负荷重（MPN-10 高）者 JAK2 抑制剂优先: JAK2 inhibitors first for those with heavy symptom burden (high MPN-10)
map.：IPSS-MF：年龄>65(+1)、HGB<100(+1)、WBC>25(+1: : IPSS-MF: age >65 (+1), HGB <100 (+1), WBC >25 (+1), peripheral blasts >1% (+1), constitutional symptoms (+1); 0 low risk, 1 intermediate-1, 2-3 intermediate-2, 4-6 high risk. DIPSS/DIPSS-plus are similar but count HGB <100 as +2 and add platelet, transfusion and karyotype items.
map.：例（年龄 65、HGB=95、WBC=15、原始=2%、无体质症状）：IPSS: : example (age 65, HGB = 95, WBC = 15, blasts = 2%, no constitutional symptoms): IPSS-MF = 0 (age not counted) + 1 (HGB) + 0 (WBC) + 1 (blasts) + 0 = 2 points -> intermediate-2 group (median survival about 48 months), consider JAK2 inhibitors and transplant indication.
map.IPSS-MF 与 DIPSS 怎么选？: How to choose between IPSS-MF and DIPSS?
map.IPSS-MF 用于初诊（含年龄项），DIPSS/DIPSS-plus 更适合已: IPSS-MF is used at diagnosis (it includes an age item), while DIPSS/DIPSS-plus suit patients already diagnosed who need dynamic re-stratification (adding platelets, transfusion dependence and karyotype); in practice both are often reported together.
map.原始细胞 >1% 为何计高分？: Why do blasts above 1% score high?
map.外周血原始细胞增多提示疾病进展/母细胞转化风险，是不良预后强指标；若≥2% 在部: Rising peripheral blasts signal disease progression or blast transformation risk and are a strong adverse prognostic marker; at 2% or more some systems weight it further, so watch for blast crisis.
